0022600158.text: Cleveland hosts Oklahoma City in its seventh game of the season, with both teams at 4-2; the Cavaliers are 2nd in the Central, one game back, while the Thunder are 2nd in the Northwest, half a game back, after losing their last two. The Cavaliers are 3-0 at home and 1-2 on the road, and they are without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (day-to-day, hamstring soreness, a game-time decision), while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Cavaliers lost both games to the Thunder, most recently a 121-113 defeat in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
